name: Untitled Goose Game
short_description: Be a horrible goose in a sleepy village: sneak, steal and honk your way through a to-do list of mischief.
sources: oracle study 2026-10-23 (public knowledge, no store fetch, no game files)
summary: Be a horrible goose in a sleepy village: sneak, steal and honk your way through a to-do list of mischief.

identity.core_loop: Read the to-do list, sneak close, grab or honk, run off flapping, hide in a bush, try the next trick.
identity.ui_and_game_feel: Silly and sly; getting caught just means being chased and shooed, never a fail screen.

hud_coverage.method: Oracle study from public knowledge of the game, in our own words; not yet measured on capture

information_grammar.note: The villagers are the stealth meter: they look up, turn, chase and shoo. The to-do list is a notepad you summon and tick off. Nothing on screen while you play.

identity.art_direction: Flat unlit colour shapes with no textures and soft tinted shadows, like a picture book printed in a few inks.

rendering.signature: Flat unlit colour shapes with no textures and soft colour-tinted shadows, like a picture book printed in a few inks.
rendering.source: oracle rendering study 2026-10-23 (public knowledge, no captures, no game files)
rendering.lesson: Tinted shadows instead of grey ones keep a flat-colour world warm and readable from far away.

tricks: Animated in Blender, played in Unity: a small set of goose clips (waddle, run with flapping wings, crouch, honk, grab)
Villagers react with clear, readable body language (look up, chase, shoo), which is the stealth readout
Neck and head lead the body, so the goose looks curious before it moves
motion.lesson: Readable reactions on the people are worth more than a big animation set; lead with the head.

sources.title: Game Developer: Road to the IGF, House House's Untitled Goose Game

motion.source: oracle motion study 2026-10-23 (public talks, interviews and breakdowns; no game files)

identity.audio_mood: Piano that follows the action, softer when sneaking and racing when you are spotted.
identity.lessons_for_abbies_world: Kid-friendly stealth: getting caught is funny, not failure; the people are the readout; music reacts to how sneaky you are.
